regulator: AGERBA — Agência Estadual de Regulação de Serviços Públicos de Energia, Transportes e Comunicações da Bahia (regulates the ferry-boat system, the Salvador–Mar Grande lancha crossing and the Salvador–Morro de São Paulo travessia, and sets tariffs by resolution). Vessel/crew certification: Marinha do Brasil, Capitania dos Portos da Bahia.
annual_basis_note: Headline series is the regulated Salvador–Itaparica crossing system (ferry-boat São Joaquim–Bom Despacho + lancha rápida Salvador–Mar Grande combined): 7.49M pax in 2025 and 3.42M pax Jan–May 2026 (~8.2M annualized), per Ministério do Turismo figures released at the Salvador–Itaparica bridge groundbreaking (2026-07-01). The Salvador–Morro de São Paulo travessia is additional to this series. FX used: 5.0727 BRL/USD (BCB PTAX 2026-07-15).
confidence: high (system totals official; per-mode and per-month splits pending — see gaps)
